bass.tags: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent electric bass guitar and acoustic drum kit. The bass guitar uses a heavily distorted, overdriven tone with high mid-range presence, playing a repetitive, syncopated riff centered on a low E pedal point. The drum kit consists of a dry, punchy kick drum and a crisp snare with minimal reverb. The rhythm follows a 4/4 time signature at 110 BPM, characterized by a driving eighth-note pulse. The bass riff utilizes hammer-ons and slides, creating a gritty, mechanical texture. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing entirely on the interplay between the distorted bass line and the steady, unembellished drum beat.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric bass riff starts, syncopated eighth notes]
[dry kick drum enters on beats 1 and 3]

[Main Section]
[snare drum enters on beats 2 and 4]
[bass continues overdriven riff with slides and hammer-ons]
[steady 4/4 rock beat continues]

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a syncopated, palm-muted riff in E minor. The drum kit features a double-kick pedal pattern with rapid sixteenth-note bursts and a high-tuned, cracking snare. A distorted bass guitar mirrors the guitar riff with a gritty, overdriven tone. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement utilizes a stop-start dynamic where the instruments cut out simultaneously for brief silences between phrases. Lead guitar layers include a wah-wah pedal effect during brief melodic fills. The production is dry with minimal reverb on the rhythm section.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted syncopation]
[double-kick drum pattern enters]

[Main Theme]
[full band, overdriven bass guitar mirrors guitar riff]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]

[Bridge]
[stop-start rhythmic accents with brief silences]
[wah-wah guitar lead fills]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord, cymbal wash]

vocals.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A dusty, sampled acoustic piano plays a repetitive four-chord progression with a slight detune effect and high-pass filtering. The drum kit consists of a muffled, thumping kick drum and a crisp, layered snare with a short decay. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords with a soft attack. A vinyl crackle texture and occasional bird chirping foley are layered throughout the mix. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor. The piano uses a swung rhythmic feel, emphasizing the off-beats. A subtle sidechain compression effect causes the piano and atmosphere to duck slightly when the kick drum hits.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, bird chirping foley]
[filtered acoustic piano chords]

[Main Loop]
[muffled kick drum enters]
[layered snare on beats 2 and 4]
[sub-bass synth follows piano root notes]

[Bridge]
[drums drop out]
[piano continues with increased high-pass filter resonance]

[Outro]
[drums and bass exit]
[piano fades out with vinyl crackle]
